proposed.name: Feature Intricacy
proposed.definition: This concept quantifies the level of detailed internal structure, complex geometry, or fine substructures present within individual repeating features.
proposed.scale_0: Concept or structure is absent / not applicable to this micrograph
proposed.scale_1: Individual features are simple, solid blocks or basic geometric shapes with minimal internal detail or substructure.
proposed.scale_3: Individual features exhibit some internal complexity, such as slight indentations, simple internal patterns, or moderately varied contours.
proposed.scale_5: Individual features possess highly complex, elaborate, or finely detailed internal geometries, intricate substructures, or convoluted shapes.
proposed.scale_10: Individual features possess highly complex, elaborate, or finely detailed internal geometries, intricate substructures, or convoluted shapes.
